text:
maria: quick follow-up on the duplicate partials issue we saw yesterday. customer UI stitched overlapping partial outputs when the gateway retried mid-stream. need a contract for making retries observable so clients can dedupe.

oleg: proposal: attach a monotonic Retry-Id + per-fragment sequence number. client treats fragments with seq <= seen_seq as duplicates and drops them. keeps semantics simple.

joy: that works but we can't force clients to buffer until a 'final' trailer. alternative: emit lightweight checkpoint trailers periodically with resume tokens so clients can reconcile partials without heavy buffering.

sam: prototype headers for discussion:
```
X-Retry-Id: r-01G8TRabcdef
X-Stream-Fragment-Seq: 42
X-Stream-Checkpoint: token=eyJhbGciOi...;ttl=30s
```
client rule: drop any fragment with seq <= last_seen_seq. accept fragments only if seq == last_seen_seq + 1 or if they contain an explicit resume token that advances seq.

oleg: need to define token format: opaque base64 with hmac and seq snapshot so edge can be stateless verifying resume validity. include minimal metadata (route, model-version, prefix-hash).

maria: rollout constraint: can't break existing clients. plan: make the checkpoint behavior opt-in per-route via header or route flag. Suggest `Prefer: resume-checkpoints=1` as opt-in for clients and default-off for existing routes.

joy: edge runtime note: KV cache entries referenced by resume tokens must be pinned for token TTL. otherwise resume attempts should fall back to hedging (forking a new generation) which can create nondeterministic outputs. call this out in compat doc.

sam: telemetry: we should emit metrics for duplicate-fragments-per-minute, resume-success-rate, and hedged-fallbacks-triggered. oleg, can you add counters and spans for retry-id and seq?

oleg: will send a telemetry PR. include tracing tag `retry.id` and `frag.seq`. also histograms for checkpoint delta (tokens between checkpoints).

maria: rollout plan: canary 2% orgs for 48h, monitor dup-rate and p95 latency. if dup-rate drops and latency impact < 5%, expand to 10% then 50%.

deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated for /v1/generate-stream (2% orgs) :rocket:

joy: user-visible SDK changes: add ResumeDetector helper that tracks seq and optionally persists last_seq per conversation. we'll ship helpers for js/python and document how to handle resumed fragments.

sam: i'll draft an RFC with diagrams (client flow, edge resume verification, fallback path) and perf numbers. include a small state machine showing hedging vs resume vs abort.

maria: action items: sam -> RFC draft; oleg -> telemetry PR; joy -> compatibility + SDK guidance; me -> canary and rollout checks. sync tomorrow 11am PT.

oleg: tiny nit: for intra-connection retries (e.g., upstream failover without client reconnect), we can preserve seq monotonicity and avoid emitting checkpoint tokens to client. make sure traces link these as resume-internal to avoid false-positive duplicate alerts.

joy: noted. i'll add a compatibility matrix: intra-conn-resume vs client-visible-resume.

maria: thanks everyone, and please flag any security implications (tokens, signing keys) in your PRs.
